title: MT69005: Physical Metallurgy Lab. (For Non
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

1.Principles of metallographic sample preparation and
observation.2.Solidification of metals and alloys, and determination of phase
diagrams.3.Observation of macrostructures.4.Work hardening of metals and alloys
and determination of recrystallization parameters.5.Study of different types of
eutectic microstructures.6.Heat treatment of different plain carbon steels, and
correlation of their microstructures and hardness.7.Microstructures of some
commercially available non-ferrous alloys.8.Microstructures, compositions and
hardness of different components used in a bicycle.
